Hi Laura — thanks for the clear details and attachments. Sorry for the friction.

Quick summary of what I'll do and what we need from you: 
- I’ve looped in Onboarding (Marissa) and Sales Ops (Ben).
- Can you confirm the DUNS and tax ID in the attached intake sheet are final? If so, we’ll do a manual activation while the Ariba invite is reissued with a tenant override.
- Please don’t close the browser window; we may ask you to try the new invite and paste any full error text.

Likely cause: our Ariba tenant routing is mapping your domain to an older tenant alias. That can surface as a tenant-boundary error and sometimes triggers an OTP type mismatch (Alphanumeric vs numeric-only). Ops can reissue an invite with the override flag and force a numeric OTP.

Next steps (I’ll own):
1) Marissa — can you open a quick Jira (or use SUP-8921) and request a tenant-override invite for Sierra Components? Please attach the intake sheet.
2) Ben — if you can pre-authorize manual activation internally, we can push the account live once legal confirms the T&Cs.
3) Laura — if you can confirm the DUNS + tax ID by reply, I’ll escalate.

Apologies again — aiming to have you live within 24–48 hours.

Jordan / Ben — taking this. Internal notes and steps for Onboarding/Platform Ops: 

What we see:
- External report: Tenant boundary mismatch + OTP rejected.
- Ariba logs (attached) show the invite was issued from tenant alias "tenant-split-eu-1" while the domain mapping for sierra-components.com is pinned to "tenant-main-us". That mismatch triggers the boundary check.
- OTP type: Ariba sometimes issues alphanumeric OTPs; our front-end expects numeric-only for that invite flow. The platform will return a "code invalid" if formats differ.

Action plan (recommended short-term):
1) Reissue invite using tenant override flag (ops console > Invite > Advanced > overrideTenant=tenant-main-us).
2) Force OTP format to numeric-only for the new invite (ops console > Invite > OTP policy = numeric).
3) If the vendor still sees an error, perform manual activation: create vendor account in vendorDB, attach intake sheet, set status = Active, and send confirmation email.
4) Log the change and link to Jira SUP-8921 for postmortem; include Ariba invite logs (I attached ariba-invite-log.txt).

Please follow the step-by-step below when you reissue (ops):
- Copy intake sheet into vendorDB; verify DUNS/tax ID match; ensure no trailing spaces in domain.
- Run domain normalization script (tools/normalize-domain) to ensure mapping to tenant-main-us.
- Reissue invite with overrideTenant and OTP policy numeric.
- Monitor the first acceptance attempt in real-time; if failure, escalate to Ariba support case 119203.

Ben/Neha — can one of you confirm legal acceptance of the intake form/T&Cs so I can proceed with manual activation if needed? I’ll standby and coordinate with Support.

Marissa Cole
